case_studies.title: Legal Document Automation
case_studies.problem: Law firm drafting same templates manually, wasting 12hrs/week per attorney
case_studies.solution: Created AI document generation workflow for contracts, NDAs, and briefs
case_studies.client_profile: Commercial law practice handling hundreds of standard vendor contracts, NDAs, employment agreements, and court filings.
challenge_details: Attorneys spending 12 hours/week copying and pasting boilerplate clauses, leading to fatigue and administrative drag.
Drafting delays caused client deals to stall while waiting for contract reviews.
Manual re-assembly introduced occasional clause omission and formatting discrepancies.
architecture: Structured client intake form via Airtable captures deal parameters, governing law, and indemnities.
LangChain pipeline matches parameters against attorney-approved modular clause libraries.
Strict prompt boundaries prevent hallucination; text generation strictly bound to firm's master templates.
Outputs formatted DOCX and PDF files with complete numbering, ready for final attorney sign-off.

testimonial.quote: Gargi's system saved our firm over $15,000 every single month in billable hours. Our lawyers spend their time in negotiation rather than copying clauses.
testimonial.author: Managing Partner, Commercial Law Practice

case_studies.title: Manufacturing Quality Control AI
case_studies.problem: Manual inspection missing defects, causing 8% quality failure rate
case_studies.solution: Deployed computer vision + AI defect detection system
case_studies.client_profile: Precision components manufacturer producing metallic and polymer parts under stringent Tier-1 tolerances.
challenge_details: Human inspectors experiencing eye fatigue after hours on high-speed conveyor lines.
8% quality failure rate slipping into packaging, resulting in customer chargebacks and recall risks.
Excessive scrap material costs averaging $32,000 monthly due to late defect discovery.
architecture: High-speed optical industrial cameras capture parts at 30 frames per second directly on the conveyor.
OpenCV normalizes contrast and aligns parts within 14 milliseconds.
TensorFlow convolutional neural network detects micro-cracks, surface burrs, and dimensional variance.
Pneumatic actuator rejects flawed components instantly while streaming metrics to plant telemetry.

testimonial.quote: Gargi's vision system paid for itself in month one by catching 156 hidden defects daily that our inspectors missed. It protected our Tier-1 automotive contracts.
testimonial.author: VP of Quality Assurance & Plant Operations

case_studies.problem: Accountants spending 25hrs/week on repetitive data entry and verification
case_studies.solution: Built AI document processing + reconciliation automation
results: Reduced audit prep from 10 days to 2 days

challenge_details: Certified staff spent 25 hours weekly manually copying numbers from PDF invoices and paper receipts into spreadsheets.

LLM classification tags general ledger accounts based on vendor category and historical bookkeeping rules.
Automated three-way match reconciles invoices against bank feeds; 97% clear automatically into ledger.
